preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(vertex_type in {'AND', 'OR', 'XOR', 'NOT', 'IN'} for vertex_type in vertex_types)
preconditions.description: Each vertex type must be one of the specified logical elements or input.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= n for index in input_indices)
preconditions.description: All input indices must be valid vertex indices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output string must have a length equal to the number of vertices n.

postconditions.expression: all(c in {'0', '1'} for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string must be either '0' or '1'.
The output string must represent the output values for each input in ascending order of their vertex indices.
